liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Touch of Grey** (2 reviews): Listener praised a delicate, high-pitched guitar lick by Jerry during the solo around the three-minute mark; Listener described the performance as a work in progress, with the band noodling before the main entry [28][36]
- **Goin' Down the Road** (1 review): Listener described the performance of this song as amazing, contributing to the show's dazzling quality [30]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): This song, along with The Other One, Morning Dew, and Sugar Mag, helped the listener recall memories [38]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-09-17.142824.fob.senn421.wise.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 28 songs; 167 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1982-09-17.nak300.friend.andrewf.99679.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 168 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1982-09-17.mtx.haugh.82208.sbefail.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 164 min; rated 4.44/5 by 9 [5]
- **gd1982-09-17.nak300.friend.andrewf.99678.flac24**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 168 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [6]
- **gd82-09-17.nak300.clugston.335.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 25 songs; 164 min; rated 4.5/5 by 16 [12]. Said about its sound: Based on the limited crowd noise present, the recording suggests the overall situation was very kind; The audience recording is clear, with audible crowd noise that does not dilute the band's sound [33][35]
- **gd82-09-17.aud.lai.2577.sbefail.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 160 min; rated 4.4/5 by 10 [23]. Said about its sound: Phil's intense drumming during this song was so loud it clipped the speakers [37]

## Around the show

- Attendees skipped school, drove to Portland, and found a mellow, stoney crowd mingling in a gravel lot [27]
- Attendees paid forty dollars for tickets, a high cost, and noted the band played a new tune [30]
- Crowd chanted for Phil to start the song, and the venue erupted when he finally did [36]
- Listener, suffering from back problems, listened to the show to recall memories and missed Jerry Garcia [38]
- Security was heard hassling tapers near the start of this song [3]
- Security was heard hassling tapers near the start of this song [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-09-17.142824.fob.senn421.wise.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Jim Wise's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell XLII-S); Transfer Info: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi Dragon)>… [1]. Also: Jim Wise recorded the show, providing a fresh transcription of his FOB audience master tape [1]
- **gd1982-09-17.nak300.friend.andrewf.99679.flac16**: taped by Tim Friend; transferred by Andrew F.; source: 3x Nakamichi CM300's > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLII-S. Set up in the row of tapers directly behind the soundboard [3]. Also: A patch from ID-91483 was used in this song from 4:31 to 6:26 [3]
- **gd1982-09-17.mtx.haugh.82208.sbefail.flac16**: source: (55%SBD + 15%AUD1 + 15%AUD2 + 15%AUD3) [5]. Also: Mark Cohen recorded the FOB using Nak 700s and a Sony D5 cassette master; The transfer chain involved a Tascam 122MKIII deck and a Tascam DA40 DAT deck [5]
- **gd1982-09-17.nak300.friend.andrewf.99678.flac24**: taped by Tim Friend; transferred by Andrew F.; source: 3x Nakamichi CM300's > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLII-S. Set up in the row of tapers directly behind the soundboard. [6]. Also: A patch from ID-91483 was used in this song from 4:31 to 6:26 [6]
- **gd82-09-17.nak300.clugston.335.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nak CM300's [12]
- **gd82-09-17.aud.lai.2577.sbefail.shnf**: source: Audience or Matrix? [23]

Listener described the performance of this song as amazing, contributing to the show's dazzling quality
Based on the limited crowd noise present, the recording suggests the overall situation was very kind

Crowd chanted for Phil to start the song, and the venue erupted when he finally did
Listener described the performance as a work in progress, with the band noodling before the main entry
Phil's intense drumming during this song was so loud it clipped the speakers
